methodology.edge_definition: Deduped, same-origin, non-asset <a href> targets extracted from each fetched page's HTML body, normalized to trailing-slash pathnames, self-loops removed.
methodology.inbound_count_definition: Count of distinct sitemap pages whose internal_links_out includes this URL (persistent site-wide nav/footer links inflate inbound counts for top-level nav items by construction).
methodology.depth_definition: BFS edge-count from / (home = depth 0) over the edge set above; null = unreachable from home via internal links (orphan).
